title: lateral_events
description: Lateral-specific event payloads. Cross-cutting events (scan, candidate, reaper, scoring, resolver, recipe, classifier) live in their own category catalogs. Keys are short-form (Object.Action); the runtime topic is `<source>.<category>.<short_form>` per the [Source].[Category].[Object].[Action] standard. These are emitted as `ctxt.lateral.<key>`.
